title: Operational System Guide
subtitle: Learn operational workflows and clinical feature guides for AI Healthcare.

scribe.title: 1. Medical Scribe (SOAP AI & Voice Input)
scribe.desc: Use this assistant to automatically compile SOAP (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) medical records from physician anamnesis.
steps: Voice / Dictation Input: Click the microphone button and dictate patient exam findings. AI automatically transcribes and structures the notes.
Manual Text Input: Type rough notes or clinical findings, and the system formats them into neat, standardized clinical SOAP records.
Save Medical Record: Click Save Medical Record to store data in the database and patient consultation history.

urgent.title: 2. Emergency Mode & Operating Room (Telemetry & Shock Index)
urgent.desc: Emergency clinical decision support with real-time vital sign monitoring and automated shock index calculations.
steps: Activate Emergency Mode: Select Emergency Mode (ED & OR) at the top bar of the Medical Scribe interface.
Automated Vital Sign Detection: State patient BP and heart rate (e.g. "BP 80 over 50, pulse 125 rapid weak"). AI immediately computes the Shock Index.
Rapid Resuscitation Protocol: Receive immediate alerts for hypovolemic shock risks, fluid bolus instructions, and direct access to emergency trauma protocols.

whatsapp.title: 3. Patient Care & WhatsApp Reminders
whatsapp.desc: Automated WhatsApp appointment reminder notifications and self-service patient triage assistant.
steps: Patient Registration: Register new appointments through the admission form with the patient's active WhatsApp number.
Automated Day-Before Reminders: The system automatically sends reminder notifications with doctor and schedule details to the patient's WhatsApp.
Self-Service Triage Chatbot: Patients can inquire about schedules and hospital facility information directly via messaging.

radiology.title: Radiology ASR (Optional)
radiology.desc: A dedicated tool for Radiologists to dictate examination findings.
steps: Click the dictation area and start speaking (e.g. "Infiltrates noted in right apical lung...").
AI will structure the spoken findings into a formal radiology report.
